subject: AWS co-sell intake: ACE papertrail + PSM matchmaking for NimbusCare
messages:
From: Marie Nguyen <marie.n@nimbuscare.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscare.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACE submission + marketplace listing: NimbusCare

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking a look at our AWS Marketplace listing submission. We just completed the ACE intake form and attached the initial compliance packet (HIPAA scope). Looking for a sense of timeline and any immediate gaps we should address for co-sell eligibility.

High level:
- Product name: NimbusCare Clinical Search (SaaS)
- Use case: clinical decision support, de-identified indexing
- Expected go-live on AWS Marketplace: Q4 2028

Can you loop in the PDM/PSM who will own the handshake and any startup items we should prioritize? Also confirm whether the ACE submission should go through the AWS team directly or via your marketplace onboarding channel.

Attachments: nimbuscare-hipaa-scope.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

Thanks,
Marie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCare
marie.n@nimbuscare.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Marie Nguyen <marie.n@nimbuscare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE submission + marketplace listing: NimbusCare

Marie — great to meet you over email and thanks for the packet. I'm Ava on the Marketplace/Partner motion at Redwood. Quick notes and next steps to keep momentum:

1) PSM/PDM handoff: Kimberly will take lead as our PDM for ACE intake and overall listing readiness. Karthik (PMM) will support co-sell pairing and go-to-market assets.

2) Immediate asks from our side:
- Confirm whether any customer data flows cross-region (we need region-specific data residency notes)
- Provide a short one-page product overview (we can help draft)
- Share expected trial/POC cadence and any estimated seat metrics

3) Timeline: if we get the checklist items back in 7–10 business days, we can submit ACE intake and push to AWS for co-sell review within ~2 weeks after.

I've attached a lightweight ACE checklist that usually speeds review. Kimberly, looping you for scheduling a 30-min sync with Marie next week.

Best,
Ava Chen
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: nimbuscare-ace-checklist.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marie Nguyen <marie.n@nimbuscare.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE submission + marketplace listing: NimbusCare

Marie — thanks for the packet and Ava for the intro. Small checklist from PDM side so we can mark ACE-ready: 

- Confirm SOC2 or equivalent evidence (if in progress, provide ETA).
- Confirm HIPAA scope doc (received) — we’ll need a short statement on PHI handling in the product.
- Provide a sample SOW or POC contract we can reference for co-sell enablement.
- Indicate which SKU(s) you want listed and any tiering/pricing model.

Can you share the SOC2 scope/status and the POC SOW? If you prefer, we can take the first draft of the one-pager and pricing blurb and return clean copy for your legal.

Proposed times for a 30-min sync: Thu 6/27 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri 6/28 08:30–10:00 PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Product Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

[Attachment referenced: nimbuscare-ace-checklist.xlsx — PDM additions added]

From: Marie Nguyen <marie.n@nimbuscare.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscare.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE submission + marketplace listing: NimbusCare

Hi Kimberly / Ava — thanks, this is helpful. SOC2 is in progress (expected completion: 2028-09-15). Attached is a short PHI-handling statement and a draft POC SOW. We'd prefer Thu 6/27 at 09:30 PT (fits into your window).

POC SOW: attached as doc stub.
PHI statement: attached as doc stub.

Also sharing a DocuSign link for the initial partner intake NDA so we can share some sensitive architecture diagrams during the sync: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/NIM-2028-ACE

Looking forward to the call — will send calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Marie
Marie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCare
marie.n@nimbuscare.com
